| Case | Positive | Negative | Condition covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 `isEvolutionIngressFailure` | `{code:CC_AGENT_EVOLUTION_INGRESS_FAILED}`→true | `{code:ECONNREFUSED}`→false | ingress code branch (direct) |
